quantity_basis: Closing V/P quantity converted to opening quoted-share units; events use first post-event trading quote regime, not a guessed report-date price adjustment.

events.note: Verified trading-unit regime; legal conversion date not asserted.

limitation: Only these known, verified quoted-unit changes are corrected. Other splits, conversions, mergers and bond amortisations may be unknown; the quantity proxy is not observed discretionary trading. Scheduled bond maturities are separately excluded from score contributions.
